# Resource: stripe_application_fee_refund

A refund of an application fee, which gives some or all of the fee back to the connected account. Without `amount`, it refunds what remains of the fee. Only `metadata` changes after creation.

~> An application fee refund can move real money. In a live-mode Stripe account, creating or changing one fails at plan time unless the provider sets `allow_live_money_movement = true`. Reading or importing one never does. The provider asks Stripe for the account's mode. See the Managing Test Data guide.

~> Stripe cannot delete or undo an application fee refund. `terraform destroy`, and a change that would replace the application fee refund, fail at plan time. To stop managing an application fee refund, remove it from the state as [Removing from State](#removing-from-state) shows; it stays in the Stripe account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Give part of an application fee back to the connected account. Without `amount`, the rest
# of the fee is refunded.
resource "stripe_application_fee_refund" "goodwill" {
  fee      = "fee_123"
  amount   = 50
  metadata = { reason = "goodwill" }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are required:

* `fee` - (Required) The ID of the parent object. Changing it fails the plan, because this resource cannot be replaced.

The following arguments are optional:

* `amount` - (Optional) A positive integer, in _cents (or local equivalent)_, representing how much of this fee to refund. Can refund only up to the remaining unrefunded amount of the fee. Changing it fails the plan, because this resource cannot be replaced.
* `metadata` - (Optional) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `balance_transaction` - Balance transaction that describes the impact on your account balance.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `currency` - Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)
* `update` - (Default `20m`)

## Removing from State

To stop managing an application fee refund whose destroy is refused, remove it from the state without destroying it. In Terraform 1.7 and later, and OpenTofu 1.10 and later, replace the `resource` block with a [`removed` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/removed) and apply:

```terraform
removed {
  from = stripe_application_fee_refund.goodwill

  lifecycle {
    destroy = false
  }
}
```

Using `terraform state rm`:

```console
% terraform state rm stripe_application_fee_refund.goodwill
```

The application fee refund stays in the Stripe account. Replacing one with `terraform apply -replace` or `terraform taint` fails in the same way, at apply.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import an application fee refund using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_application_fee_refund.goodwill
  id = "fee_123/fr_456"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_application_fee_refund.goodwill
  identity = {
    fee = "fee_123"
    id  = "fr_456"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `fee` (String) The ID of the parent fee.
* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the application fee refund.

Using `terraform import`, import an application fee refund using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_application_fee_refund.goodwill fee_123/fr_456
```
